description: Shows or changes auto top-up (off by default): when the balance falls below `threshold` credits, the card saved for auto top-up buys `pack` automatically, at most `monthly_max` times a month. Call without arguments to see the status. Turning it on without that card (or with `new_card: true`) returns a Stripe link where the person saves one and sees the agreement (nothing is charged then). Ask the person before turning it on. Free; each top-up is a normal pack purchase. While `available` is false it is paused for everyone: turning it on returns `auto_topup_paused`.

new_card.description: true: return a Stripe link to replace the saved card

name: auto_topup
title: Check or change auto top-up
